LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 SENTENCES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Sentences
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Sentences, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: how much more..., when/who/why/ what else, for example, who else attended the ceremony? How much more sugar was bought?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Sentences together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and communication: Articulating signs clearly as learners fingerspell and sign words related to the theme.

• Digital literacy: Creating with technology as learners use digital devices to practice constructing questions.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as learners, in pairs or groups, construct questions using the patterns.

Link to other Subjects:

Learners are able to relate the concept of interrogatives learnt in English to similar concept in Kiswahili.
